findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, and no test files anywhere in app/ — every behaviour is guarded only by the external acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Add a zero-dependency `node:test` suite (Node 24 is already required by engines) covering the pure helpers in src/api.mjs and src/render.mjs against the spec's worked examples

findings.issue: sortRows has three interacting subtleties (missing-values-last in both directions, tie-break fallback, direction flip that never applies to the both-missing path) with no test pinning any of them
findings.suggestion: Table-driven tests over rows with null power/accuracy, duplicate names, and both sort directions

findings.issue: 'Latest English flavor text' relies on reverse().find(); a refactor to find() returns the oldest entry and nothing fails
findings.suggestion: A 3-line unit test with two en entries plus whitespace/f/f characters

findings.issue: User-supplied q is reflected into an attribute and relies solely on the untested escapeHtml (app/src/render.mjs:3) for both correctness and XSS safety
findings.suggestion: Test escapeHtml with quotes, angle brackets, and the search value round-trip

findings.issue: homeUrl's 'omit empty/default params' rule is a one-line regression waiting to happen (e.g. page=1 leaking into pushed URLs)
findings.suggestion: Unit-test homeUrl for the empty, defaults-only, and fully-filtered cases

findings.issue: getHomeData combines three filters with hard-to-reason failure modes (unknown type or generation silently yields zero results rather than an error or ignore)
findings.suggestion: Fixture-based tests for each filter alone, combinations, unknown filter values, and page clamping

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id > 10000) is duplicated in api.mjs and views.mjs:141 with no test proving Mega forms stay out of every list
findings.suggestion: One test per list path (type page, ability page, move page) using a fixture containing a >10000 id

findings.issue: onError renders the Not-found page with status 500 for any API failure, so upstream 5xx is indistinguishable from a bug; untested either way
findings.suggestion: A route-level test with a stubbed failing fetch asserting the status and rendered h1

summary: The agent wrote no tests at all: no test script, no runner in dependencies, no test files, and its only verification was the provided acceptance suite. The app is unusually rich in silently-breaking pure logic (humanize, latest-entry selection, sort ordering, URL param omission, filter intersection), all trivially unit-testable with node:test at zero dependency cost. Once the acceptance suite stops being run on every change, any refactor of src/api.mjs or src/views.mjs is completely unguarded.
